string-array.name: whats_new_items
string-array.item: Update from ZIP: replace an existing project\'s files from the three-dot menu while keeping name, chats, and project id.
GitHub Connect: Sign in, workflow scope, personal access token, Import, and Commit & push (including public clones).
Renaming a project now updates its /workspace path to match the new name.
Persian (Vazirmatn) font, localization, and 9Router provider fixes from recent builds.
ZIP import crash after open project fixed (greeting recursion).
